\[
\sum_{d|250} \max A_d,
\]

where the sum ranges over all positive integer divisors \( d \) of 250.

(For a finite nonempty set \( S \), we define \( \max S \) as the largest element of \( S \).)

Let \(\varphi\) be Euler’s totient function, with \(\varphi(1)=1\).

First note that \(|A_i|=i\), and if \(g=\gcd(i,j)\), then
\[
A_i\cap A_j=A_g.
\]

**Key decomposition.** For each \(n\), define
\[
B_n=A_n\setminus \bigcup_{\substack{d\mid n\\d<n}}A_d.
\]
One can prove by induction that the sets \(B_n\) are pairwise disjoint, \(|B_n|=\varphi(n)\), and
\[
A_n=\bigcup_{d\mid n} B_d.
\]

Now focus on the divisors of \(250=2\cdot 5^3\). Write them as
\[
5^b \quad\text{and}\quad 2\cdot 5^b,\qquad b=0,1,2,3.
\]
The block sizes are
\[
|B_{5^b}|=|B_{2\cdot 5^b}|=\varphi(5^b),
\]
so the row sizes are
\[
1,\ 4,\ 20,\ 100.
\]

Let the eight values \(\max A_d\) be sorted:
\[
S_1\le S_2\le \cdots \le S_8.
\]

If \(m\) of the divisors have maximum at most \(t\), they must form a downward-closed ideal in the \(2\times 4\) grid of divisors. If that ideal has \(h\) odd divisors and \(k\) even divisors, with \(0\le k\le h\le 4\), then the required total number of elements that must be \(\le t\) is
\[
Q_h+Q_k,
\]
where
\[
Q_0=0,\quad Q_1=1,\quad Q_2=5,\quad Q_3=25,\quad Q_4=125.
\]
Checking the possible pairs \((h,k)\) gives the minimal required values
\[
(S_1,\dots,S_8)\ge (1,2,6,10,30,50,150,250).
\]
Therefore
\[
\sum_{d\mid 250}\max A_d
\ge 1+2+6+10+30+50+150+250
=499.
\]

This bound is attainable. Choose disjoint blocks
\[
\begin{aligned}
B_1&=\{1\}, &
B_2&=\{2\},\\
B_5&=\{3,4,5,6\}, &
B_{10}&=\{7,8,9,10\},\\
B_{25}&=\{11,\dots,30\}, &
B_{50}&=\{31,\dots,50\},\\
B_{125}&=\{51,\dots,150\}, &
B_{250}&=\{151,\dots,250\},
\end{aligned}
\]
and for all other \(n\), choose disjoint sets \(B_n\) of size \(\varphi(n)\). Define
\[
A_n=\bigcup_{d\mid n}B_d.
\]
Then
\[
|A_i\cap A_j|=\sum_{d\mid \gcd(i,j)}\varphi(d)=\gcd(i,j),
\]
so the conditions are satisfied.

The corresponding maxima are
\[
1,2,6,10,30,50,150,250,
\]
whose sum is \(499\).

\[
\boxed{499}
\]
